ConsumerIdentifier.description: The name of the consumer accounts that have an association with a producer datashare.

CreatedDate.description: The creation date of the datashare association.

Status.description: The status of the datashare association.

StatusChangeDate.description: The status change date of the datashare association.

schema.description: Resource for managing Redshift DataShares. This is a read-only resource type.

AllowPubliclyAccessibleConsumers.description: Whether the datashare can be shared to a publicly accessible cluster.

DataShareArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the datashare.

DataShareAssociations.description: Associations between producer and data consumers.

ProducerArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the producer namespace.
